items.docs:
Retrieves the current production status of a card at a kiosk machine.

**Best practice**: Subscribe to the [card production status change](/guides/developer/webhooks/event-types#cards-card-production-status-change) webhook for real-time notifications. Use this endpoint only when you need to synchronously check the status.
